name: Ashrah
Text: At the start of Set, you may switch any cards from your hand with any weapons or projectiles in your energy pile.

name: Baraka
Text: Your rival discards the top card of his deck when you link from a punch in a combo. (*) Your weapon attacks do +1 damage.

name: Bo'Rai Cho
Text: Twice while taking damage from an attack, you may put a damaged punch at the bottom of your deck instead of your discard pile if you have more energy than your rival.

name: Darrius
Text: When you play a punch with no effect or link from a punch with no effect, you may put a card in your discard pile on top of your deck. (*) Your attacks without text cannot be discarded by effects.

name: Kabal
Text: You may always look at your rival's face-down cards in the arena. (*) When one of your kicks or weapons hits, you may choose a player to put a random card in his hand at the bottom of his deck and draw a card.

name: Sindel
Text: When you finish a combo with a projectile, you may have any rival put his hand at the bottom of his deck and draw the same number of cards. (*) Your attacks linked from a projectile cost +1 energy to block.

name: Sub-Zero
Text: When you finish a combo with 2 or more consecutive punches or projectiles that hit, you may end the step.

name: Death Trap
Text: Flip when you finish an attack that hit. Remove your rival's discard pile.

name: Dirty Tricks
Text: Flip when you attack. Name a block. Your rival cannot play that block this attack.

name: Emissary of the Gods
Text: Flip when your rival attacks. Discard an attack from your hand that has damage equal or greater than your rival's attack to block it.

name: Fatal Blow
Text: Flip after you finish an attack that hit. Discard a card in your rival's energy pile.

name: Flawless Victory
Text: Flip when your rival loses a round. If he dealt you no damage in that round, you win the game.

name: Hidden Intentions
Text: Flip when you attack. You may link a projectile off this attack.

name: Lin Kuei Training
Text: MORTAL KOMBAT ONLY. (*) Flip when you attack. Your attack gains 'Discard the top 3 cards of your rival's deck.'

name: Power Up
Text: Flip when you attack. Put 5 attacks from your discard pile at the bottom of your deck. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Trapped in the Korner
Text: Flip when your rival has blocked 2 or more consecutive attacks in a combo. Your rival cannot attack this step.

name: Unfair Advantage
Text: Flip at the end of Discard. Your rival discards a random card from his hand.

name: Arrowed!!!
Text: Discard the top 2 cards of your rival's deck.

name: Battle Mastery
Text: Choose up to X rival's face-down cards in the arena. Those cards cannot be flipped this turn. X = the number of weapons in your energy pile.

name: Berserk Chop
Text: HIT - Switch up to 3 weapons in your hand with the same number of cards from your energy pile.

name: Bitter Blade
Text: You may set each event damaged by this attack.

name: Bludgeon Fist
Text: Your other attacks in this combo do +1 damage.

name: Chest Clincher
Text: HIT - You may put up to 3 cards in your rival's discard pile on top of his deck.

name: Choy Lay Power
Text: HIT - You may switch any weapons in your hand with the same amount of cards from the top of your deck.

name: Dark Fists
Text: This attack is unblockable and it's damage cannot be modified. (*) If played by Sub-Zero, discard the top card of your rival's deck.

name: Deadly Palm
Text: HIT - Your rival's attacks in his next action cannot deal more than X damage. X = the number of attacks with the same attack trait in his energy pile after he pays the attack's cost.

name: Decapitation!
Text: This attack does +2 damage when linked from an attack that hit.

name: Double Handed Uppercut

name: Flurry of Blows
Text: Your rival's first attack in his next action does -1 damage.

name: Hammer Palm Strike
Text: HIT - Each player discards X cards from the top of his deck. X = the number of cards in each player's hand.

name: Head Crush
Text: This attack does +X damage to a max of +5. X = each weapon in your energy pile.

name: Head Throw
Text: Your rival must have more energy than you to block this attack.

name: Heavy Damage
Text: HIT - Put a weapon from your discard pile into your energy pile.

name: Killer in White
Text: HIT - Your rival's low attacks in his next action do -1 damage for each punch in your energy pile, to a max of -2.

name: King Palms
Text: This attack does +1 damage for each weapon in your energy pile.

name: Left Hook
Text: Discard the top card of your rival's deck.

name: Neck Crank
Text: If your rival has more cards in his removed pile than his discard pile, this attack is unblockable.

name: On the Edge
Text: This attack does +1 damage for each face-down card in the arena to a max of X. X = the number of punches in your energy pile.

name: Out Prioritized
Text: HIT - You may put the next attack played in this combo on top of your deck instead of your energy pile or removed pile.

name: Power Clash
Text: If this attack linked from an attack that hit, discard the top 3 cards of your rival's deck.

name: Rocky Road
Text: Each time a block is damaged by this attack, your rival takes one extra damage.

name: Seeker Shot

name: Skillful Skinning
Text: Your rival cannot play more than 2 attacks in his next action.

name: Sliding Kick

name: Electric Torpedo

name: THE Uppercut
Text: HIT - Your rival's first attack in his next action does a max of X damage. X = the damage this attack deals.

Text: HIT - Your rival keeps -1 cards in his hand during this turn's Discard for each kick in your energy pile.

name: Ankle Biter
Text: HIT - Any player with 5 or more energy discards from his energy pile until he has 5 energy.

name: Back Kick

name: Foot Slice

name: Hell on Earth

name: Ice Clone

name: Kneecap Strike

name: Tiger Tail Kick

name: Under Cut

name: Hat Trick
Text: If you have a projectile in your energy pile, your rival discards a card from his hand.

name: Protective Teleport
Text: If you have a punch in your energy pile, you may pay 1 energy to set an event from your discard pile.

name: Hotaru

name: Catfight

name: Graceful Beauty
Text: Flip at the start of battle. Both players draw 3 cards. Both players may set cards. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Insanity
Text: Flip when you attack. Your attack does +10 damage. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Dark Alliance
Text: HIT - Your rival's attacks cost +X energy this turn. X = the number of weapons and kicks in your energy pile.

name: Ice Maker

name: Jade's Spear Kabob

name: Kabal's Spinner
Text: Guess all the titles of the cards in your rival's hand. Your rival reveals his hand. If no cards were guessed incorrectedly, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Noob Smoke's Dark Shadows

name: Noob Smoke's Ninja Stars
Text: Draw a card. (*) HIT - Draw a card.

name: Sub-Zero's Freeze and Throw
Text: If 3 or more previous attacks in this combo created an effect that discarded cards from your rival's deck, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Ashrah's Voodoo
Text: If cards have been switched from your hand 3 or more times this turn, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Bo' Rai Cho's Puke
Text: HIT - Attach this card to your rival's character instead of putting this into your energy pile. While attached, your rival's attacks do -1 damage.

name: Hotaru's Lava Burst
Text: Block all your rival's low attacks this step. Remove this card.

name: Kabal's Plasma Blast
Text: HIT - Your rival reveals all but 1 random card in his hand. (*) Look at your rival's deck without changing its order.

name: Power Hook
Text: HIT - If linked from a projectile, your rival's attacks cost +1 energy this step.

name: Sindel's Banshee Scream
Text: HIT - Your rival draws 10 cards and then discards 10 random cards from his hand.

name: Sindel's Super Scream
Text: If your rival has passed in his previous 2 actions this step, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Sub-Zero's Ice Blast
Text: HIT - Your next attack this step is unblockable. Your rival must pass for his next action.

name: Bite Me
Text: MORTAL KOMBAT ONLY. (*) Block all of your rival's high attacks this step. Remove this card. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Bo Knows Defense
Text: Your rival's low attacks do -1 damage this step.

name: Drunken Master
Text: Flip when you attack. Draw 2 cards. Remove this card. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Searching the Realms
Text: MORTAL KOMBAT ONLY. (*) Flip at the start of the Draw. Search your deck for a card and put it in your hand. (*) Limit 1 per deck.

name: Hooked on Fatalities
Text: While in your energy pile with one or more projectiles, your rival's attacks cost +1 energy unless they are 0 cost attacks. Only 1 Hooked on Fatalities can modify your rival's costs.

name: Twin Fangs
Text: While in your energy pile, discard the top X cards of your rival's deck at the start of the Draw. X = the number of projectiles in your energy pile.

name: Liu Kang
Text: When you play an attack, you may pay 1 energy to have it do +3 damage. (*) At the start of the Draw, discard the top card of your rival's deck.

name: The Dragon King
Text: You play your kamidogu at no cost.

name: Dairou
Text: You may remove 3 cards in your discard pile at the start of Draw. (*) When you draw a card, you may draw if from the bottom of your discard pile if that card is a weapon. (*) Your punches do +1 damage for each different kamidogu you control.

name: Kira
Text: When your effects discard the last card(s) in your rival's hand, you may play a kamidogu. (*) When you play a kick or weapon, it does +1 damage for each card you have in your hand over your rival's hand.

name: Kobra
Text: When a punch or kick is damaged from your deck, you may switch it with a card in your hand. (*) When you play an attack, you may reveal a copy of it from your hand to have the attack do +4 damage.

name: Li Mei
Text: When you finish a combo that ends with 2 or more consecutive kicks and/or projectiles that hit, you may play a kamidogu. (*) Discard the top 2 cards of your rival's deck when you play or gain control of a kamidogu.

name: Mileena
Text: Your attacks that link into kicks also link into weapons, and vice versa. (*) When you finish a combo, you block all your rival's attacks in his next action that do X damage. X = number of attacks in your combo.

name: Scorpion
Text: When one of your projectiles or weapons hits, discard a rival's card in the arena. (*) When one of your attacks finish, you may discard it from your energy pile to discard an attack in your rival's energy pile with the same trait.

name: Shujinko
Text: Your deck may contain cards with any character's title. (*) Your first attack each turn does +X damage. X = the number of Kamidogu you control.

name: Obligatory Violence
Text: Flip when you attack. Your attack does +4 damage. (*) You cannot link off of this attack.

name: Vixen Vendetta
Text: Flip as an action in Battle. Put the top card of your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Arm Snapper
Text: Reveal a random card in your hand. Your rival's first attack in his next action does -X Damage. X = the cost of the revealed card.

name: Axe Throw
Text: HIT - Name a block. Your rival cannot play that block during this combo.

name: Back Stomp
Text: HIT - Your rival's attacks in his next action do -1 damage.

name: Chaos Axe Kick
Text: When an attack in this combo puts any card(s) into your deck from its effect, it does +X damage. X = the number of cards it puts into your deck

name: Dairou;s Stretch and Slam
Text: This attack does +3 damage for each kamidogu you control.

name: Eye Gouge
Text: HIT - Name an attack trait. Your rival's first attack in his next action cannot have that trait.

name: Frankensteiner
Text: HIT - Rearrange the order of your discard pile.

name: Front Flip
Text: HIT - Your rival cannot use 'HIT -' effects in his next action.

name: Hair Kut
Text: While in your energy pile, your rival cannot play any copy of an attack he has in his energy pile.

name: Jawbreaker
Text: If any attack in this combo lowers your rival's damage, increase the amount lowered by 1.

name: Kenshi's Telekinetic Push
Text: When this card is put in your energy pile choose a card in your rival's energy pile that creates an effect while in his energy pile. The chosen card has a blank text box while this card is in your energy pile.

name: Kira's Neck Slicer
Text: If your rival has no cards in his hand, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Klothes Klipping

name: Li Mei's Flipping Heel Kick

name: Lightining From Above
Text: Discard the bottom 2 cards of your rival's deck.

name: Mileena's Head Bite
Text: If your rival passed in 3 consecutive actions this step, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Raiden's Shocking Touch
Text: HIT - Search your rival's deck for up to 4 cards and discard them. Your rival shuffles his deck.

name: Scorpion's Head Rip
Text: If you discarded 3 or more cards in your rival's energy pile this step, this attack does +15 damage.

name: Sindel's Star Screamer
Text: HIT - Choose 2 cards in your rival's discard pile. Your rival discards 2 random cards from his hand and puts the 2 chosen cards into it.

name: Shujinko's Flaming Fist
Text: When your modifiers increase damage to this attack double that increase up to +10.

name: Bloodletter
Text: This attack does +1 damage for each card in your rival's hand.

name: Crackling Legs Projectile
Text: HIT - Gain control of a rival's kamidogu.

name: Darrius' Target Practice
Text: Search a player's deck for a card and discard it. That player shuffles his deck. (*) HIT - Switch a punch in your discard pile with a card in your energy pile.

name: Ki War
Text: If played by Sub-Zero, your rival's next action this step is skipped. (*) HIT - Discard the top card of your rival's deck for each projectile in your energy pile.

name: Klean Break
Text: This attack does +4 damage.

name: Knife Pinning
Text: HIT - Choose a trait in your rival's energy pile. Your rival's first 2 attacks in his next action cannot have that trait.

name: Missile Murder
Text: When the next attack in this combo hits, put a card from your discard pile into your energy pile.

name: Overloaded
Text: HIT - Reveal a random card in your rival's hand. Discard X cards from the top of his deck. X = the revealed card's cost.

name: Pinpoint Disarm
Text: HIT - Your rival cannot play weapons this step.

name: Skirt Sweep
Text: Your rival's attacks go to the discard pile instead of the energy pile when they finish this step. Each time he does this, he puts the top card of his deck into his energy pile.

name: Staff Trip
Text: HIT - If your rival has cards in his energy pile, his first attack in his next action cannot be a 0 cost attack.

name: Tactical Thunder
Text: HIT - Your rival must pay +1 energy to block your next attack in this Combo.

name: Toe Krush
Text: Pay any amount of energy up to your total energy. Your rival cannot play attacks in his next action that cost less than or equal to the energy you just paid.

name: Tomahawk Chop
Text: If this is your 5th or higher attack in this combo, this attack does +5 damage.

name: Trick Shot
Text: HIT - Put the kick closest to the top of your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Kounterslice
Text: If you have a kick in your energy pile, shuffle this card into your deck.

name: Krossbar
Text: If you have a weapon in your energy pile, put this card into your energy pile.

name: Left Sidestep
Text: MORTAL KOMBAT ONLY. (*) When this card is damaged from your deck, you may pay 1 energy to put it into your hand.

name: Golf Swing
Text: While you have a weapon in your energy pile this step, your rival cannot take control of the kamidogu you control.

name: Nimble
Text: You may pay 1 energy to put a block from your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Right Sidestep
Text: MORTAL KOMBAT ONLY (*) When this card is damaged from your deck, you may pay 1 energy to put it into your hand.

name: Roller
Text: If you have a punch in your energy pile, gain control of a rival's kamidogu.

name: Earthrealm
Text: Put the top card of your discard pile into your energy pile.

name: Orderrealm

name: Kenshi

name: Raiden

name: Scorpion's Bloody Spear

name: Shujinko's Master Swordplay
Text: If this attack is played from the top of your deck with Shujinko's effect, it does +15 damage.

name: Ashra's Heavenly Light

name: Bo' Rai Cho's Earthquake
Text: While in your energy pile, increase the number of times per attack you can use Bo' Rai Cho's text by +1.

name: Sub-Zero's Cold Shoulder

name: Chaosrealm

name: Edenia

name: Outworld

name: Quan-Chi

name: Dragon King

name: Knife Hand Slash
Text: Any modifiers that increase the damage of this attack are doubled

name: Dragon King
Text: Your side deck can only contain Kamidogu. (*) During Set, you must play a Kamidogu each turn. If you cannot, discard the top 15 cards of your deck. (*) When a rival would steal a kamidogu you control remove it instead and discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

name: Dragon King
Text: Your attacks do +3 damage and gain +3 chip. (*) Your rival's attacks do -1 damage and gain -3 chip. (*) When you flip an event, you may remove it to use its text instead of paying its cost.
